title: Final inspection.
officialText:
There shall be a final inspection of all permitted work. Final inspections shall comply with sections 28-116.2.4.1 through 28-116.2.4.3.

Exception: A final inspection shall not be required for minor electrical work as defined in section 28-101.5.

(Am. L.L. 2016/151, 12/6/2016, eff. 1/1/2018; Am. L.L. 2024/128, 12/21/2024, eff. 12/21/2025)
